# FlutterInit

> Generate production-ready Flutter projects with your chosen architecture, state management, backend, and navigation — plus AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md / DESIGN.md for AI coding tools.

Website: https://flutterinit.com
Dashboard: https://flutterinit.com/create
Blog: https://flutterinit.com/blogs
Sitemap: https://flutterinit.com/sitemap.xml

## Product

FlutterInit is a Flutter project generator (web + CLI). Pick architecture (Clean, Feature-First, MVVM, …), state (Riverpod, Bloc, Provider, MobX, …), backend (Firebase, Supabase, Appwrite, or none), and routing (go_router, AutoRoute). Output includes wired auth screens, theme tokens, and AI context files so Cursor / Claude Code follow the stack.
